t: A small browser engine for making pixel games, worlds, and stories.
steps: Open the Bitsy page on itch.io, or download a local copy.
Make a small test world with one room.
Add an avatar, a few tiles, and one line of dialogue.
Export the game and open the web page.
Look at the Bitsy class curriculum by Hal Meeks.
Decide where students will save their game files.
Review any public sharing on itch.io before students post games.
